Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_CauterizePain_t: Pain added when cauterizing a wound (0-100).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_CauterizeDamage: Extra damage the burn deals to the treated body part (0-50).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_ScabDurationDay: How many days a cauterized scab stays on the body part before fading away.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_ScabPainFloor_t: Pain on a scabbed part never drops below this value (0 disables the floor).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_RemoveScabPain_: Pain added when scraping a scab off with a scalpel.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_ScabScratchSeve: Scratch heal time from removing a fresh scab (first quarter of its life); above 17 the panel calls it severe.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_ScabScratchMode: Scratch heal time from removing a mid-age scab; above 14 the panel calls it moderate.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_ScabScratchLigh: Scratch heal time from removing an older scab.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_ScabScratchOld_: Scratch heal time from removing a scab in the last quarter of its life.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_DigBulletPain_t: Pain added when digging a bullet out with bare hands (0-100).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_DigBulletSeveri: Digging always turns the wound into a deep wound; this is the extra heal time added.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_DigBulletBleedi: Digging causes or worsens bleeding; this is the extra bleeding time added.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_DigBulletInfect: Digging always causes or worsens a local wound infection; this is the infection level bump.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_CrudeStitchedDu: How many days the crude stitched state stays on the part before expiring.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_CrudeStitchPain: While crude stitched, every wound on the part adds this fraction of extra pain (0.2 = one fifth extra, 0 disables).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_RemoveCrudeStit: Excising a crude stitch with a scalpel pushes the part's pain up to this value (default 100 = max).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_CrudeStitchReop: Deep wound recovery time from excising a fresh crude stitch (first quarter); above 10 shows as severe.
Deep wound recovery time from excising a middle-aged crude stitch; above 8 shows as moderate.
Deep wound recovery time from excising an older crude stitch.
Deep wound recovery time from excising an old crude stitch (last quarter).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_MorphineAddicti: Addiction value added per morphine injection (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_InjectionRelief: Withdrawal value removed per morphine injection (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_WithdrawalClimb: Game minutes for withdrawal to close the gap to the addiction baseline.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_WithdrawalFallR: Fraction of the above-baseline opioid withdrawal that wears off per game day (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_AddictionDecayR: Fraction of the opioid addiction baseline that decays per game day during severe withdrawal (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_AmphWithdrawalC: Game minutes for amphetamine withdrawal to close the gap to the addiction baseline (a full baseline crosses the severe threshold after half a game day).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_AmphDecayRate_t: Fraction of the amphetamine addiction baseline that decays per game day during severe withdrawal (0-1; much longer than opioids, default 0.36).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_AmphPanicPerMin: Panic added per game minute during amphetamine withdrawal (0-100).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_AmphUnhappiness: Unhappiness added per game minute during amphetamine withdrawal (0-100).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_AmphDrunkPerMin: Drunkenness added per game minute at severe amphetamine withdrawal or worse (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_AmphSleepReduct: Fatigue removed per game minute during mild and moderate amphetamine withdrawal (0-1, i.e. staying awake).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_CrossWithdrawal: Health percent lost per game hour while opioid AND amphetamine withdrawal are both active (0-100, until death).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_FentanylAddicti: Addiction value added per fentanyl injection (0-1, 1.0 goes straight to the cap).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_FentanylRelief_: Fraction of withdrawal removed per fentanyl injection (0-1, 1.0 clears it outright).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_OxycontinAddict: Addiction value added per oxycontin dose (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_OxycontinRelief: Withdrawal value removed per oxycontin dose (0-1, default five doses clear it).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_NaloxoneAddicti: Addiction value removed per naloxone injection (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_NaloxoneHungerT: Hunger and thirst added per naloxone injection (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_HazeMaxAlpha_to: Maximum opacity of the fullscreen withdrawal haze at full withdrawal (0-1, 0 disables the haze).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_SufentanilPatch: How many days the sufentanil patch stays on the right upper arm before falling off.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_SufentanilPaink: Painkiller dose added per game minute while the patch is on (0-1, capped at 1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_SufentanilWithd: Withdrawal value removed per game minute while the patch is on (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_SufentanilAddic: Addiction value added per game minute while the patch is on (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_SufentanilClear: While the patch is on, pain, panic, unhappiness and boredom are pinned at zero.
